newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones average down more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones average down more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average lost more than 50 points Friday after stronger-than-expected housing starts in April revived concern that the Federal Reserve may raise interest rates to slow the economy's growth.
At 10:38 a.m. EDT, the Dow was off 50.28 points at 7,283.27, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading.
